description: Add a CI ratchet for @shadcn/lint warnings on the app components/ui folders and for the count of local shadcn component copies. Both counts compare with a committed baseline and fail only when a count goes up. Step 1 of PM order A-32.
deviation_notes: Two of the six @shadcn/lint rules are out: no-raw-colors and no-unknown-classes need a Tailwind theme build, and the build worker times out for primary-advantage and reading-advantage at every budget up to 120 s. The bundled fallback grammar is not stable enough for a ratchet, so the gate counts the four rules that do not read the theme. The plugin stays out of the workspace: no root devDependency and no pnpm-lock.yaml change, so the affected-app selector prints [] for a scripts-only change. CI installs the plugin into RUNNER_TEMP/shadcn-lint with npm, and the script loads it through SHADCN_LINT_DIR. A missing variable or plugin exits 2.
